verdict.rationale: Perplexity publishes an API reference with request/response schemas (sonar-post) and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec. Its docs also point to an interactive Playground where users can run Search queries without an API key, so runnable exploration exists for at least one API. However, nothing shows the API reference pages themselves are interactive (e.g., a try-it console), and the Playground is only documented for Search. Missing for 10: evidence of in-reference runnable 'try it' examples across endpoints, Playground coverage beyond Search, independent or hands-on corroboration.
